bib.title: HuBERT: Self-Supervised Speech Representation Learning by Masked Prediction of Hidden Units

question: How can speech representations be learned self-supervised given multiple sounds per utterance, no sound-unit lexicon and no segmentation?
hypothesis: A masked-only prediction loss over offline cluster targets is resilient to poor cluster quality, and consistency of targets matters more than correctness.
contributions: HuBERT: BERT-like masked prediction of offline k-means cluster labels over continuous input
Cluster ensembles and iterative refinement of targets
Matches or beats wav2vec 2.0 on 10min to 960h fine-tuning; scales to 1B parameters

method.summary: Offline k-means (MFCC first, then intermediate HuBERT layer features) gives frame labels; a wav2vec 2.0-style CNN+transformer predicts the labels of masked frames with a cosine-similarity softmax. Pretrained models are fine-tuned with CTC for ASR.

datasets.name: LibriSpeech 960h
datasets.preprocessing: 39-dim MFCC (13 coef + first and second derivatives) for iteration-1 k-means

datasets.name: Libri-light 10-min, 1h, 10h; LibriSpeech 100h, 960h
datasets.split: fine-tuning; Libri-light splits are half train-clean-*, half train-other-500; dev/test-clean/other for eval

models.name: wav2vec 2.0, DiscreteBERT, DeCoAR 2.0, IPL, slimIPL, Noisy Student, Conformer

training.objective: cross-entropy on cluster labels, L = alpha*Lm + (1-alpha)*Lu, alpha=1 default; logits are cosine similarity / tau, tau=0.1; fine-tune with CTC
training.lr: peak 5e-4 / 1.5e-3 / 3e-3 for BASE / LARGE / X-LARGE; fine-tune peak swept in [1e-5, 1e-4]
training.lr_schedule: linear ramp up then linear decay to zero
training.batch_size: at most 87.5 s audio per GPU (BASE, 32 GPUs), 56.25 s (LARGE, 128 GPUs), 22.5 s (X-LARGE, 256 GPUs); fine-tune at most 200/80/40 s per GPU on 8 GPUs
training.steps: BASE it1 250k, it2 400k; LARGE and X-LARGE 400k; ablations 100k
training.regularisation: layerdrop 0.05 (BASE); mask span l=10, p=8% of frames as starts; conv encoder frozen in fine-tuning; freeze-step for transformer
training.hardware: 32 / 128 / 256 GPUs for BASE / LARGE / X-LARGE pretraining; 8 GPUs fine-tuning (GPU type not stated)

other.kmeans: iter1 k-means C=100 on MFCC; later C=500 on 10% sample of layer features, scikit-learn MiniBatchKMeans, mini-batch 10,000 frames, k-means++ 20 starts
other.schedule: BASE it2 labels from layer 6 of it1; LARGE/X-LARGE labels from layer 9 of BASE it2 (third iteration)
other.finetune_sweep: peak lr, schedule, steps, freeze step, encoder output masking prob, chosen on dev-other WER

inference.decoding: wav2letter++ beam search in Fairseq: log pCTC + w1 log PLM + w2|Y|; w1, w2 searched with Ax Bayesian optimisation
inference.samples: ablations: one run per cell; k-means stability 10 trials

parameters.LM: n-gram and transformer LMs on official LibriSpeech LM data

metrics.name: WER
metrics.definition: word error rate on dev/test clean/other

metrics.name: PNMI
metrics.definition: I(y;z)/H(y), phone-normalised mutual information of k-means labels vs forced-aligned phones

metrics.name: phone purity / cluster purity
metrics.definition: expected conditional probability of the most likely phone given cluster / of most likely cluster given phone

eval.protocol: WER on LibriSpeech dev/test; ablations use dev-other with n-gram LM, fixed hyperparameters, 100k pretrain steps, 10h fine-tune; no significance tests; single runs

availability.weights: pre-trained and fine-tuned models at the same fairseq URL

limits: Evaluated on English ASR only; generation tasks listed as future work.
Training needs a multi-phase pipeline (k-means then re-cluster), which authors plan to replace with a single phase.
Lags methods combining pre-training with self-training (Table III).
Ablations are single runs at 100k steps; no seeds or significance tests; GPU type, precision, weight decay not stated.

terms.definition: phone-normalized mutual information: percentage of uncertainty about the phone label eliminated after observing the k-means label

lineage.note: architecture and masking follow wav2vec 2.0; main baseline
